skill.name: reporting-issues
skill.description: Create a concise report from a troubleshooting session.
skill.summary: Turns troubleshooting work into a clear issue report.
skill.author: Emz1998

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable code, network access, filesystem access, or secret handling.

content.value_statement: Troubleshooting sessions can leave important details scattered across notes and chat history. This skill helps Claude, Codex, or Claude Code create a clear issue report.
actual_capabilities: Triggers a workflow for reporting on a troubleshooting session.
Directs the assistant to use the troubleshoot-report-generator agent.
Focuses the output on a troubleshooting report.
Supports documentation after support, debugging, or incident work.
Runs as a prompt-only skill with no scripts or executable files.
limitations: Requires the troubleshoot-report-generator agent to be available.
Does not define report sections inside this skill file.
Does not run diagnostics or collect logs automatically.
Does not verify facts beyond the information provided by the user.

use_cases.title: Summarize a Support Session
use_cases.description: Convert notes from a customer support investigation into a concise issue report.

use_cases.title: Document a Bug Investigation
use_cases.description: Turn debugging notes, symptoms, and attempted fixes into a structured report for a team.

use_cases.title: Capture Incident Follow-Up
use_cases.description: Create a readable record of findings, impact, and next actions after troubleshooting an incident.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Troubleshooting Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a simple report from short notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a troubleshooting report from these notes: [paste notes]. Include the problem, what was checked, outcome, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Support Handoff Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a report for another support person.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this troubleshooting session into a handoff report. Include customer impact, environment, symptoms, actions taken, current status, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Engineering Issue Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a report for an engineering backlog.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an engineering issue report from this investigation. Include reproduction details, expected behavior, actual behavior, evidence, likely cause, and recommended owner.

prompt_templates.title: Incident Review Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a detailed report after a complex incident.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this troubleshooting transcript and create an incident follow-up report. Separate confirmed facts, assumptions, unresolved risks, root cause candidates, and corrective actions.

output_examples.input: A user cannot sign in after a password reset. Support checked account status, reset email delivery, and browser console errors.
output_examples.output: Issue report covering the sign-in failure, checks performed, evidence found, current status, and next recommended diagnostic steps.

output_examples.input: An API endpoint returned intermittent 502 errors during deployment. Logs show upstream timeouts and retries.
output_examples.output: Troubleshooting report summarizing the deployment window, symptoms, log evidence, suspected timeout cause, mitigation, and follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: A desktop app crashed after an update. The team tested rollback, cleared cache, and captured the error message.
output_examples.output: Structured report with environment details, reproduction notes, attempted fixes, observed error, workaround status, and escalation notes.

best_practices: Provide timestamps, environment details, error messages, and steps already tried.
Separate confirmed facts from guesses and open questions.
Review the final report for accuracy before sharing it with stakeholders.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to invent missing evidence or root causes.
Do not include secrets, access tokens, or private customer data in the prompt.
Do not use the report as a substitute for required incident review processes.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a troubleshooting report from notes, chat history, or investigation details that you provide.

faq.question: Does it run diagnostic commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is prompt-only and does not run commands, read files, or access systems by itself.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide symptoms, environment details, timestamps, errors, attempted fixes, results, and any remaining questions.

faq.question: Does it guarantee the root cause?
faq.answer: No. It can organize evidence and identify likely causes, but it cannot prove facts without supporting data.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive incidents?
faq.answer: Use sanitized notes. Remove secrets, credentials, personal data, and confidential customer information before prompting.
